# Cyber Kings: Solar System - themed placeholder coats of arms for hegemonies, empires and kingdoms
# that have no real-world flag (formables, world hegemonies, Earth regions, Lunar/Martian/outer-world realms),
# plus duchies and counties on the other worlds whose names come from myth (table MYTH in title_designs.py).
# Generated by _dev/scripts/title_coas/gen.py from title_designs.py - edit title_designs.py, not this file.
# Vanilla CK3 emblems only, except e_empire0531 (the real Commonwealth of Nations flag, textured emblem).
# Real flags for Earth titles live in zz_cyber_kings_earth_flags.txt; no key appears in both files.
